bio: In this dinky, modern bistro near Avenue de Clichy (think polished concrete floor, trendy light fittings, wooden tables and an eclectic play list), you will taste exciting, vibrant food, at bargain prices at lunchtime. In the evenings, the menu is depicted by dishes to share: mussels, haddock and ricotta in a spicy sauce; gnocchis, crumble and a parmesan emulsion; white asparagus, cream cheese and bloody oranges in a flaky pastry tart....
